title: Current State
description: Derived, deterministic snapshot of the active governing state for a scope.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the current-state schema.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this state was generated.

constitution_version.description: Version of the Constitution in effect when this state was generated.

approved_canon.description: Active Approved Canon entries, ordered by entry_id.

working_context.description: Active Working Context entries, ordered by entry_id.

active_state.description: Merged key-value state from all active entries.

open_items.description: Aggregated open items from all active entries.

source_entry_ids.description: IDs of the active (non-superseded) entries that produced this state.
